context: Two teens swap stories about a chaotic group project
purpose: Teach: そいつ/先程/予め/不完全/つかむ/加わる/おこなわ/聞かさ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ聞いて、先程のグループ発表、まじで不完全燃焼で終わったんだけど。
lines.en: Hey listen, the group presentation just now ended in a totally half-baked mess.
lines.style: Frustrated teen venting right after class, casual rapid speech

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そいつは災難だな。予め役割とか決めとかなかったのかよ?
lines.en: That sucks man. Didn't you guys decide roles and stuff in advance?
lines.style: Sympathetic but teasing male teen, blunt and direct tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 決めたよ!でも当日になって別のグループから二人加わることになってさ、もうカオス。
lines.en: We did! But on the day, two people from another group ended up joining us, total chaos.
lines.style: Exasperated teen girl explaining disaster, hands-waving energy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、流れをつかむ前に本番じゃん。発表自体はちゃんとおこなわれたの?
lines.en: Yikes, so you barely caught the flow before showtime. Did the presentation actually happen?
lines.style: Curious teen leaning in, half-laughing at her misfortune

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一応ね。でも先生から後で延々とダメ出し聞かされて、泣きそうだった。
lines.en: Sort of. But afterward I got an endless stream of criticism from the teacher, almost cried.
lines.style: Defeated teen slumping, dramatic self-pitying tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うちのクラスも先週そんな感じで、リーダーが進行つかめなくて地獄だった。
lines.en: Our class was like that last week too, the leader couldn't grasp the flow, total hell.
lines.style: Commiserating teen sharing his own war story, dry humor

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかる〜。次は事前に台本作って絶対リベンジする。
lines.en: Totally get it. Next time I'm prepping a script beforehand and getting revenge for sure.
lines.style: Determined teen perking up, fired-up resolution voice

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おう、頑張れ。手伝ってほしかったら遠慮なく俺に言えよ。
lines.en: Yeah, go for it. If you want help, don't hesitate to tell me okay?
lines.style: Supportive teen offering casually, slightly gruff but warm
